prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a reported loss of consciousness of less than one minute at the scene, followed by headache, dizziness, photosensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Initial neurological examination showed intact cranial nerves, normal strength and sensation, and a mild impairment in tandem gait and balance. Cervical strain was also noted with reduced range of motion and paraspinal tenderness. Imaging of the head was negative for acute intracranial pathology. The patient was placed on cognitive and physical rest for the first week, then gradually reintroduced to daily activities under a graduated return-to-activity protocol. Over the course of 29 visits, the treatment plan included vestibular rehabilitation exercises, oculomotor training, cervical physical therapy, and periodic symptom scoring. Headache frequency and dizziness decreased steadily, and concentration tolerance improved with each phase. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported near-baseline symptoms with occasional mild headaches during prolonged screen use. Balance testing had normalized. Ongoing home exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur.
